title.en: Tale 40 — Everyone Is a Little Right
title.ar: מעשה 40 — לכל אחד יש קצת צדק

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: At the end of his life Juha was old.
He sat in the yard with the grandchildren.
They asked him for a last story.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אני אספר על עצמי.
sentences.en: He said: I shall tell about myself.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: כל החיים צחקו ממני.
sentences.en: He said: all my life they laughed at me.
He said: they said that I am foolish.
He said: and perhaps it is true.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אבל תשימו לב לדבר.
sentences.en: He said: but notice one thing.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הם זוכרים כל סיפור.
sentences.en: He said: they remember every story.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הם מספרים אותם לילדים.
sentences.en: He said: they tell them to their children.
He said: and whoever tells, learns.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אז מי הטיפש כאן?
sentences.en: He said: so who is the fool here?
The small grandson said: you, grandfather.
Everyone laughed loudly in the yard.
He said: you are right, child.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ולכל אחד יש קצת צדק.
sentences.en: He said: and everyone is a little right.
